entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support'.
Connecting you to our Returns department. Please hold.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David... I'm calling because I need to return some cycling shoes. I'm just so sad about it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-9981-73. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and was so excited for these shoes. It's just really disappointing.
I understand. Thank you for that information, I see the order right here. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They're just not working for me. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats multiple times, but they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride in them.
Getting blisters from new gear is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Okay... I just really need this money back. I was hoping these would be the ones, you know?

Thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and I have good news. Your order was delivered 21 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, I can absolutely process a full refund for these cycling shoes.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you so much.

You are very welcome. I've just started the return process. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives the item.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help, David.
I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
